notes.title: 2018.1 released
notes.notes: Unity game engine updated for 2018.2 and video configuration moved to in-game options menu. Launcher window removed.

notes.title: XBOX360 Gamepad problems
notes.notes:
Unfortunately there is some problems using XBOX360 Gamepad. All buttons is not recognized and playing with illogical setup may be annoying.

We try to discover and fix functionality in next update.

notes.title: Major updates
notes.notes:
Update 2017.4 released
- Fixed missing decal texture bug in macOS version
- Optimized code for better performance in gameplay


Update 2017.3 released
- All story and commando missions updated for more detail and action
- Ragdoll physics and detaching body parts
- More blood and gore!
- Soldiers won’t stick to walls anymore when moving
- Weapon looting will not change the current weapon to less powerful anymore
- Automatic weapon change when out of ammo
- Dead zone setting added to gamepad configuration
- Many smaller improvements and optimizations
